reviews.text: I took my cat to Fat Cat Flats for a Lion Cut, and they were absolutely amazing! The level of care they provided was spectacular. You can truly tell they are incredibly careful and experienced with handling cats. The cut itself turned out excellent, and I couldn't be happier with the results. I 100% recommend them to anyone looking for a specialized cat groomer. We will definitely be coming back soon!

I highly recommend Paradise Cat Boarding and Grooming / Fat Cat Flats! From the moment I walked in with my two long-haired Persian cats, Momo and Mochi, I felt completely comfortable and welcomed. The staff was incredibly friendly and took the time to ask exactly what style of cut I wanted for my cats instead of just rushing through the process.

John was especially amazing. He explained all the different grooming styles and cuts they offer, which helped me decide on the teddy bear plush cut for both of my babies. He was so patient, sweet, and genuinely cared about making sure both my cats and I felt comfortable. What impressed me the most was how he took Momo out and started petting her, and within minutes she was purring and relaxed. That NEVER happens because she is very skittish and usually hides from everyone except me and my husband. Seeing her trust him so quickly honestly spoke volumes about how caring and experienced they are with cats.

When I came to pick them up, I also met another employee who helped John with my cats, and both of them were wonderful. They brought Momo and Mochi out to make sure I was happy with the cuts and asked if I needed anything else adjusted. I was honestly so impressed by that level of care and customer service. You can truly tell they want both the pets and owners to leave happy.

The prices were also amazing and very affordable, especially for the quality of grooming and attention they provide. They gave my cats the cutest plush cuts, trimmed their nails, bathed them, and even cleaned their eyes for me. My cats looked absolutely adorable and felt so soft and clean afterward.

I highly recommend Paradise Cat Boarding and Grooming / Fat Cat Flats to anyone looking for cat grooming. They truly love cats, know exactly what they’re doing, and treat your pets with kindness and patience. I will absolutely continue bringing Momo and Mochi here!
Amazing value for services and great customer service. They make sure everything is to your liking before you leave. So glad I’ve found a good place to bring my Persian cat!

Original review: (08/2023)

I had such a wonderful experience here. James’s level of customer service is phenomenal. I don’t remember the groomer’s name but she did a fantastic job at grooming my long-haired Persian cat. Their pricing is affordable compared to other places that charge higher fees.

I would highly recommend Fat Cat Flats For all your grooming needs. I’ll definitely be back.

Update (01/2026)

I took my newly adopted long haired baby to get a lion manes cut recently and I was met with the same great hospitality from three years ago.

I saw the recent negative reviews, but I personally had a great experience. Wishing a small family business to go out of business is spiteful and inappropriate. Shame on you.

Regardless, thank you for taking care of my little boy. I would trust this business to groom my cats. Price is the best around Houston and quality of work is great.

Nicole was AMAZING with my very anxious and vocal cat! She was very patient and did an amazing job! It was the first time having my cat bathed so it was high stress but she did an incredible job! 10/10

A friend recommended this place. I have a long haired cat so sometimes she will get things in her fur on her bum. They did an excellent job giving my cat a sanitary shave and her nails are trimmed perfectly! Great prices too. Will be returning!

It was my first time getting Luna groomed and Fat Cat Flats was recommended online. I decided to give them a shot and I will definitely be bringing Luna back! They had no trouble in taking care of her despite Luna being a bit sassy at times especially with bathing. Not sure what magic they did but it absolutely worked and she was groomed PERFECTLY. John was extremely pleasant to talk to and the groomer was awesome as well. You can tell they are cat people and love cats. The pricing was more than reasonable. They both are great people! Would recommend anyone who needs their cat groomed to come here.
Thank you for your kind review.

I was overly impressed with my sweet Maddie’s service today! My sister-in-law recommended this place, and we decided to give it a shot—so glad we did!

John was extremely friendly, and his customer service was top-notch! I loved how welcoming and kind he was. Maddie has very bad separation anxiety, but when I got her back and we started driving home, I could immediately tell she was so calm and relaxed. Her fur felt incredibly soft, and they did an amazing job brushing out all her excessive hair! Her nails were also trimmed perfectly.

If you love your fur babies, bring them here! They’ll be so well taken care of.

We were so happy with Maddie’s experience that we will definitely be returning as repeat clients!
Nicole and John are awesome. They are both  accommodating when it comes to my cats haircut ( modified lion cut). They are very professional and friendly. I wouldn't take my siberian to anyone else.

Groomers were AWESOME.I just dropped by to get elderly cat's nails trimmed. You can do a walk-in for nail trims. Really appreciate the compassion, my cat got sick on the way there and they helped clean the kennel so she was in a clean carrier on the way home. The nail trim took all of 90 seconds (they're PROS!) and cost no more than $10. They showed great care to our cat. It was a 20 minute drive, worth it! Hope to get her groomed next time. If you're older cat needs a nail trim please bring her to these guys!
I take my cats here and so glad I found this place especially for cats.  They do a great job with them.

John has completely enthralled that cat who usually hisses and bats at strangers. She completely relaxes into him when he handles her. Before John, I was the only person who could handle that cat without her hissing and scratching.

John was super flexible & supportive. That boarding was over 30 days

I've boarded my cats here multiple times now. I love this place.
The groomer always does great work removing the fleece of my little Persian!!  My cat is very relaxed when I pick her up at the end of the session.

I’m so glad we can across fat cat flats it’s been a struggle to find someone to shave my cat. I went on a day right after a storm so I was surprised to see that they were still open! They had boards on the windows for protection from the storm. When I walked in the people working there were very nice and attentive it was our first time bringing our cat here. They also had a small shop inside selling all kinds of cat things.

I dropped my cat Jewel 💎 around 11am picked her up at 3pm. I asked them to shaved her down and to give her a lion cut.
They did a great job! The way they maneuver and are able to manage the cats is amazing. I had asked her how long she had been doing this for she said over 15 years of experience. That made a lot of sense she knows ways of calming and being able to hold a cat without hurting them or stressing them. I was very surprised to see it myself the way she handled my cat like a pro! Her cut came out very cute ☺️

Really appreciate and like Fat cat flats, would definitely recommend bring your cat here if they need to be shaven down! We will definitely be returning customers. 😄
